title: leucanthemum coronopifolium subsp. tenuifolium
intro: Leucanthemum coronopifolium subsp. tenuifolium, commonly known as Mountain Dandelion, is a plant species in the daisy family that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health conditions due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Dandelion include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, making it useful in the treatment of wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Dandelion include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
